title: Exact localization of K-flat total tensor
statement: On a ringed site small in its coefficient universe, total tensor by a K-flat complex A [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-sp-total-tensor-summand-interface] descends to a functor T_A on the unbounded derived category, with a canonical representative natural isomorphism between Q followed by T_A and tensor(A,-) followed by Q. These functors admit the coherent shift and triangulated structure supplied by signed total tensor. A chain map A->B induces the normalized natural transformation T_A->T_B. It is invertible for a quasi-isomorphism between K-flat arguments. Levelwise tensor also descends on derived strict towers, with the canonical representative isomorphism.

proof.text: K-flat tensor preserves all quasi-isomorphisms by the signed total tensor theorem. Apply localization to get T_A, its comparison e, and the levelwise tower descent; evaluation detects tower quasi-isomorphisms.

proof.text: Lift transformations in the first tensor argument through localization. To invert a quasi-isomorphism A->B between K-flat arguments, choose a K-flat resolution P->U of the other factor. In the natural tensor square three sides are quasi-isomorphisms by K-flatness of A, B and P, so the fourth is too. Localization and essential surjectivity give an invertible natural transformation.

proof.text: The signed homotopy tensor functor and its coherent shifts descend through homotopy localization. Transport its triangulated structure through the representative isomorphism to obtain the triangulated structure on T_A.
